independent_controls.limitation: Generated YAML stays modified; persistence rollback is outside this lot.

observed_limitations.name: concurrent_same_output_staging_window
observed_limitations.detail: Another writer staging a selected path after final preflight loses that staged version when --only commits current worktree. No global transaction or same-output concurrency guarantee.

observed_limitations.name: trusted_hook_can_widen_commit_before_postvalidation
observed_limitations.detail: Hook using git add stages an extra route in Git temporary index. Helper rejects postvalidation without undoing the already created commit; hooks are not sandboxed.

validation.history: Independent harness source was stable before/after; shared tests were still expanding and their two hashes are preserved in its log. Final 61-case run used stable final source and final test hashes.

baseline.execution: Parent reproduction log inspected; not independently rerun against old production.

design_changes_reviewed: No broad git add and no manual reset rollback; normal git commit --only controls the temporary preparation.
Callers pass only outputs their producers reported changed, preventing an unrelated dirty PROJECT file from inclusion by YAML-only commands.
New/untracked selected outputs, detached/unborn HEAD, sparse/split indexes, in-progress operations, special index flags and repository/index selectors are explicitly unsupported and rejected.
limitations: Git executable, configuration, clean filters and hooks are trusted executable dependencies. This helper does not sandbox them. A hook can stage another path and create a widened commit before postvalidation rejects it; no automatic destructive undo is attempted. This was reproduced.

There is no atomic global transaction against another writer staging/changing the same selected output between final preflight and Git acquiring its own lock. Such staged content can be replaced by --only. This was reproduced; staging of a different path was independently shown preserved and excluded.
Commit ownership is at selected-file granularity. Pre-existing edits within a file rewritten by a producer are not separated by hunk.
The two generated working-tree files may remain changed when commit fails. No persistence transaction/rollback, downstream ledger guarantee or unrelated defect is closed by this review.

Configured hooks may reject or hang; this change does not guarantee bounded execution of arbitrary hook code. No operational hook, real checkout commit, push/publication, network, real signing key, hardware or ATTESTED artifact was used.
No-op returns an observed existing valid HEAD, not a newly created commit. Postvalidation observes parent/routing scope; it does not certify signature, authorship or immutable future branch state.
